trans-unit.source: Don't be sad. I'm sure the elves will relent one day.
trans-unit.target: Don't be sad. I'm sure the elves will relent one day.

trans-unit.source: Yes, please cheer up. Your mother would want you to be happy.
trans-unit.target: Yes, please cheer up. Your mother would want you to be happy.

trans-unit.source: I...I can't! I wanna see her again! Just one more time!
trans-unit.target: I...I can't! I wanna see her again! Just one more time!

trans-unit.source: Pipe down already! As if you're the only one who has it bad! Think how they must feel...
trans-unit.target: Pipe down already! As if you're the only one who has it bad! Think how they must feel...

trans-unit.source: It's okay. At least you found out your mother's still alive.
trans-unit.target: It's okay. At least you found out your mother's still alive.

trans-unit.source: That's reason enough to be happy, right?
trans-unit.target: That's reason enough to be happy, right?
